title: color vertex labels
explanation:
### Description

This example colors vertex labels of a directed graph. Each vertex is labelled with its integer ID and the label text is rendered in red using vtkLabeledDataMapper.

**dataset → input → layout → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkGraphLayout](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphLayout.html) computes vertex positions using a layout strategy.
- [vtkGraphToPolyData](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGraphToPolyData.html) converts graph edges to polydata lines.
- [vtkIntArray](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkIntArray.html) stores the per-vertex label values.
- [vtkLabeledDataMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLabeledDataMapper.html) renders text labels at point positions.
- [vtkMutableDirectedGraph](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkMutableDirectedGraph.html) builds the directed graph.
- [vtkSimple2DLayoutStrategy](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSimple2DLayoutStrategy.html) arranges vertices in 2D.
